name: rex-sessions
title: Rex Sessions
description: Switch between Rex sessions, or start one from your sesh config or zoxide directories
author: esttorhe

commands.name: connect
commands.title: Connect to Rex Session
commands.description: Show a Rex session in the app, creating it first when needed

preferences.name: rexPath
preferences.title: rex CLI
preferences.description: Path to the rex command. The macOS app ships it inside its bundle.

preferences.name: rexApp
preferences.title: Rex app
preferences.description: The app to bring to the front after switching.

preferences.name: searchPath
preferences.title: PATH for sesh and zoxide
preferences.description: Directories to find sesh and zoxide in, separated by colons. A leading ~ is expanded.

preferences.name: includeZoxide
preferences.title: Directories
preferences.label: Include zoxide directories
preferences.description: List zoxide's directories so any of them can become a session.

preferences.name: includeSesh
preferences.title: Sesh Config
preferences.label: Include sesh config entries
preferences.description: List entries from sesh that can create a local session.

preferences.name: includeRemote
preferences.title: Remote Hosts
preferences.label: Include remote hosts
preferences.description: List sessions from the hosts configured in Rex's host list.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
